//: BrettjoAstro FITS Importer — optional path overrides. Copy this file to ~/Library/Application Support/Astro Import/config.json (Mac) or %LOCALAPPDATA%\Astro Import\config.json (Windows) and edit. Precedence: environment variable > this file > built-in default. All paths may use ~. The defaults below are the Mac's; on Windows the same ~/Documents/Astro paths land in your user folder on C:, and the archive default is E:\Astro Image Data. See PARITY.md for every key on both platforms.
//archive: Optional — only if you keep an archive on another computer (see PC-SYNC.md). Leave the URL empty otherwise — the ship agent is then never installed and no share is ever mounted for you.
//ship: 1.7.0. A ship that would leave the archive with less than this many GB free sends nothing. Leave these out unless you need them: ASTRO_MACHINE_ID (this computer's short name: a to z, 0 to 9 and -, at most 32) and ASTRO_MACHINE_LABEL (the name people read) default to mac/Mac and pc/PC; ASTRO_SHIP_FOLDER (this computer's folder under the archive's _verify) defaults to mac on a Mac and pc on Windows, and two computers must never share one; ASTRO_PC_HASH_MINUTES (archive PC only, default 360) stops the nightly hash at a file after that long.
//desk: Astro Desk (the panel's Archive tab, 1.6.0). Where Siril is, for Start Siril here, and the Observatory's dataset (target states and hours). On Windows the defaults are C:\Program Files\Siril\bin\siril.exe and E:\Astro Config Data\Observatory\dataset.json.
